body:
Follow-up from the #3068 Phase 3 closing audit (evidence: doc/2026-11-09_audit_3068-phase3-closing.md, on PR for #3069). The audit inventoried every parse-then-dereference boundary in bin/, scripts/, pkgs/, and pm-stack's non-aggregator handlers. The sites below are boundaries the #3068 phases missed and the same rule covers — validate the shape you deref, at the boundary, before any side effect; absence is not emptiness. Each item is its own small fix; do them as separate small PRs, in roughly this risk order:

1. bin/sync-models.mjs:127 — models.dev response read as `(await res.json()).response?.models || {}`: absence-as-emptiness (corollary 3). A shape drift reads as "zero models" instead of an error.
2. pkgs/id/web response casts: src/main.ts (8 .json() sites, several `as {…}` casts), src/world.ts:433,566, src/home.ts:105 — first-party server responses dereferenced by cast with no shape parser (contrast image-browser.ts / image-upload.ts in the same package, which use named parsers — the compliant pattern).
3. pm-stack/dispatch: src/github.ts casts ({id}, {token, expires_at}, {number, html_url}), src/queue.ts:119,136 TaskRow[] casts, src/auth.ts:109 response deref.
4. pm-stack/projector/src/github.ts:191 — generic helper returns `(await res.json()) as T` (contrast its own unknown-first sites in the same file); src/server.ts:252,346 inbound req.json() bodies.
5. pkgs/atlas-search/worker: inbound casts src/index.ts:75, src/cache_do.ts:82; response casts src/index.ts:92,113.
6. pkgs/cold-store-reaper/worker/src/index.js:108 inbound request.json() job deref; :159 resp.json() payload (dist/worker.js is the built copy).
7. pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx/daemon.ts:463,476,537 — `(await res.json()) as T` / `as Resolution` on daemon responses.
8. bin/codedb-bridge.mjs:250 response parse raced then dereferenced; bin/provider-catalog-sync.mjs:525 res.json() returned to dereferencing callers.
9. Exporter scripts returning API responses unvalidated to dereferencing callers: pm-stack/meta-exporter (:195, :330), pm-stack/supabase-export, pm-stack/opencode-usage-export. (cloudflare-export's GraphQL errors shape is excluded — already fixed under #2608.)
10. pm-stack/opencode-claimant (claimant.py, poll.py): queue-broker responses parsed and acted on (session launches) without a shape check. Loopback, token-authed, first-party — lowest risk in this list, same rule.

Acceptance: each numbered item either lands a boundary shape check in the surface's own error vocabulary, or is dispositioned on this issue with the one-line reason it is not a trust boundary. Reference the probe matrix from the contract statement (aggregator README, "Parsed-shape contract (#3068)"): null, array, scalar, {}, each relied-on field wrong-typed.
